operating_notes.text: Cupid has a single reportable segment, 'Personal care', covering male and female condoms, water-based lubricants and IVD kits.
The 4.40 Cr convertible warrants lapsed unexercised by 13 September 2025 and the ₹96.30 Cr upfront amount was forfeited under SEBI ICDR Regulation 169(3).
Cupid Invesco Limited, a wholly owned foreign subsidiary, is awaiting RBI approvals before share capital is transferred.
FY26 revenue mix: male condoms ₹181.11 Cr (51.60%), new FMCG products ₹84.26 Cr (24.01%), female condoms ₹60.72 Cr (17.27%), IVD kits & lubricants ₹24.97 Cr (7.11%).
Exports contributed ₹208.13 Cr, 59.30% of FY26 revenue, across 125+ countries.
FMCG products are available across 1.50 lakh+ retail outlets; modern trade 2,934+ stores listed, 4,000+ projected for FY27.

timeline.summary: On 28 April 2026 Cupid disclosed a SEBI administrative warning dated 23 April 2026 for failing to disclose the cancellation of a preferential issue under Regulation 30(7) of the LODR Regulations.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹119.96 Cr (+112.4% YoY), net profit ₹36.26 Cr (+215.0% YoY).
Cupid's Q4FY26 investor presentation set FY27 revenue target of ₹600 Cr with net margin above 30%, and FY29 revenue of ₹1,150 Cr, after FY26 revenue of ₹357.71 Cr beat its ₹335 Cr guidance.
Shareholders via postal ballot and e-voting appointed Mr. Bontha Prasada Rao (DIN-01705080) as Independent Director on May 20, 2026.
On June 2, 2026, CMD Aditya Kumar Halwasiya acquired 26,00,000 open market shares of Cupid Limited, increasing his direct shareholding to 33.13%.
Aditya Kumar Halwasiya, promoter, declared no new share encumbrances under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for Cupid Limited as of 31st March 2026.
Cupid converted 3 million warrants of Baazar Style Retail into equity shares at ₹328.25 per share on October 15, 2026.
